items.title: General Dynamics' Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Revenues Improve Y/Y
items.summary: GD beats Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as all four segments rise, led by Aerospace and Marine Systems, while cash strengthens.

items.title: General Dynamics Stock Bucks Defense Sector Slump Following Earnings Beat
items.summary: General Dynamics  has managed to avoid much of the defense stock pain that came after fighting began in Iran.  Wall Street was looking for earnings per share of $3.96 from sales of $13.5 billion.  Orders were higher than sales, a good omen for future revenue growth.

items.title: Reading Between The Lines Of RTX's Latest Call
items.summary: RTX's headline numbers looked great, but the real story on its earnings call was about a coming slowdown and a tough choice in its engine business.

items.title: General Dynamics Tops Second-Quarter Forecasts as Aerospace and Marine Businesses Drive Growth
items.summary: General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter results, with both earnings and revenue exceeding Wall Street forecasts as robust demand across its Aerospace and Marine Systems businesses supported growth. Shares edged 0.

items.title: General Dynamics (GD) Q2 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
items.summary: While the top- and bottom-line numbers for General Dynamics (GD) give a sense of how the business performed in the quarter ended June 2026, it could be worth looking at how some of its key metrics compare to Wall Street estimates and year-ago values.

items.title: General Dynamics (GD) Tops Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: General Dynamics (GD) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +7.34% and +4.48%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) Reports Strong Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 8.1% year on year to $14.09 billion. Its GAAP profit of $4.24 per share was 6.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
